Determine English SMS financial relevance and legitimate/phishing/uncertain/exclude label from actual evidence, not a generic ham/spam label. Personal money conversations, telco top-ups, advertising, university IT notifications, unrelated services are exclude. Define intent, requested_action, destination, event_or_claim consistently using concise semantic descriptions; absence of action is NONE. Allowed message_function: account_security, account_restriction, transaction, payment, transfer, card, fraud_alert, verification, refund, banking_app, credential_request, financial_service, other. Require English language, SMS channel, financial relevance, safe=true and confidence>=0.8 for approve. Output every supplied frame_id once, no extras. Review independently without detector information. All review fields must reflect uncertainty honestly. Use your own judgment; no other reviewer output is supplied.
